messages:
maria-collections: FYI: DriftSail (acct DS-803) invoice INV-20256 is now 35 days past due. Sent two reminder emails and a card decline notice — no response. Billing shows last charge failed. Can we discuss a payment plan to avoid churn? @sam-finops ?

billing-bot: Automated dunning email #3 sent to finance@driftsail.com (attempted at 1772530599). Delivery: soft-bounce.

alex-cs: I hopped on a quick call with their AM — they said a short VC bridge delay. They want to keep the instance running and asked for split payments over ~60 days. No objection to adding a signed plan.

sam-finops: Draft proposal from finance: 3-installment plan to clear balance. Suggested terms:```
- Total due: $28,400 (INV-20256)
- Payment schedule: 40% immediate, 30% in 30 days, 30% in 60 days
- One-time admin fee: $50 (waivable)
- Failure policy: 2 auto-retries then suspend service
- Require e-signature on payment plan doc
```
Need @olivia-fmgr sign-off on fee waiver and suspension hold. Also flag to CS: attach usage breakdown CSV to the plan.

olivia-fmgr: Ok to approve the 60-day split. Waive the $50 admin fee for this account given ARR and retention risk, but only if Legal signs the agreement. Approve hold on suspension while plan is active.

maria-collections: Thanks. I'll prepare the payment plan and the e-sign package. alex-cs — can you confirm the finance contact is finance@driftsail.com and cc legal@driftsail.com on the intro? Also I'll create a payment_plan_id in billing: `PP-17725-DS`.

alex-cs: Confirmed finance@driftsail.com and legal@driftsail.com. I'll intro legal now and ask them for the signed PO or e-sign back. I'll also attach the monthly usage CSV for Feb/Mar.

maria-collections: Drafted and sent plan for signature. Creating payment schedule in billing portal now.

billing-bot: Payment plan created: https://pay.redwood.ai/pp/PP-17725-DS — expires in 7 days. Scheduled charges: 2026-04-01 (40%), 2026-05-01 (30%), 2026-06-01 (30%). (1772610000)

alex-cs: Nice. I'll follow up with them tomorrow to push signature. :thumbsup:

maria-collections: I'll monitor and report back by EOD Friday if signed or if we need to escalate to collections.
